# MATH 346

Mathematical and statistical software for students who need to compute, analyze, visualize, and explain results they can defend.

This course uses MATLAB and R, with generative AI treated as a professional assistant whose output must be tested, interpreted, and documented.

::: {.pill-row}
<span class="pill">MATLAB</span>
<span class="pill">R</span>
<span class="pill">Reproducible reports</span>
<span class="pill">Numerical methods</span>
<span class="pill">Data analysis</span>
<span class="pill">AI-aware validation</span>
:::
:::

::: {.course-map}
## Course Workflow

1. Ask a precise question.
2. Choose a computational representation.
3. Write or adapt code.
4. Check the result.
5. Communicate the conclusion.
6. Document any AI assistance.
:::
:::

## Course Question

The central question of the course is not "Can I make MATLAB or R run?"

It is:

> Can I turn a mathematical or statistical question into a reproducible computational answer that is correct, interpretable, and honestly communicated?

## Public Materials Policy

This website contains original course materials and links to references. It does not redistribute textbook PDFs, publisher slide decks, answer keys, exams, or private student work.
